COME FOR THE PLANES. LEAVE INSPIRED. ✈️

An airport open house can turn a passing curiosity into a lifelong love of flying.

In a new October 28 report, General Aviation News photographer Hayman Tam takes us inside Hayward Executive Airport’s September open house in California: more than 30 aircraft on display and more than 50 community groups, colleges and aviation organizations meeting the public.

There were homebuilts, classic light airplanes, amphibians and warbirds—and a chance to experience aviation history in the air. The Stockton Field Air Museum brought a Twin Beech for passenger flights, and every ride sold out before the event ended.

That’s general aviation doing something wonderful: opening the gate, sharing the airplanes and giving someone a reason to imagine themselves in the cockpit. 💛

Source: Hayman Tam, General Aviation News, October 28, 2026. Event held in September.
